dash.blurb: KVAZR shows the charge in the tray and sets up wireless peripherals from several makers — without a vendor suite each. Plug a headset in by cable or dongle, a mouse or a keyboard, and they turn up here by themselves.

dash.mice.text: Logitech over the dongle and Bluetooth. DPI, report rate, buttons
dash.keyboards.text: NuPhy and anything VIA-compatible. Layers, macros, lighting

Без класса и без данных — обычно служебн: No class and no readings — usually system nodes rather than hardware
Показываются тем, что о них знает систем: Shown with what the system knows about them: name, class, connection and charge, if the device reports one
Настраивать нечего: устройство отдаёт то: Nothing to set: the device gives only what the row already shows.
Устройство не подключено. Показаны после: The device is not connected. The last known readings are shown
Устройство подключено на уровне Windows,: Windows sees the device, but it answers none of the requests we know. There is nothing to set — below is everything that could be read.
Подключено по Bluetooth: доступен только: Connected over Bluetooth: only the charge is available. Settings work over the dongle or the cable
Наушники не отвечают. Включите их или по: The headset is not answering. Switch it on or bring it closer — control works over the dongle and over the cable alike
Через донгл клавиатура не отдаёт ни заря: Over the dongle the keyboard gives neither charge nor VIA — layout, layers and lighting are edited over the cable.
Заряд по XInput отдают только настоящие: Only genuine Xbox controllers report charge over XInput; button remapping and profiles are the vendor's own road.
Диаграмма направленности, аппаратный gai: The polar pattern, the hardware gain and the lighting live in the vendor's protocol — at the baseline they do not exist.
Аппаратные эффекты и эквалайзер колонки: Hardware effects and a speaker's equaliser are the vendor's own road. At the baseline this is the same sound page a headset gets.
Кодек Bluetooth, аппаратная громкость и: The Bluetooth codec, the hardware volume and the charge over a dongle cannot be read at the baseline — only the vendor's protocol gives them.
У мышей других вендоров этих строк не бу: Mice from other makers will not have these rows: HID++ is Logitech's protocol, and a Razer or a Glorious keeps its name, class and connection.
Эти устройства не показываются на дашбор: These devices are absent from the dashboard, the tray and the notifications. The Windows pairings are untouched: put one back in the list and its readings resume.
Сочетания работают, пока приложение запу: The shortcuts work while the application is running, in any window. They act on the primary device — the one whose state the tray mark shows.
Audeze's RACE was reverse-engineered here. VIA and HID++ compatibility follows the published protocol descriptions
